questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code loads related data for the order report? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A customer has 40 recent orders from 2 warehouses, 120 order lines in total, and 300 distinct SKUs across them. How many SQL statements does recent_order_views issue?
choices: 43: one for the orders, one per order for its lines, and one for the stock rows
3: one for orders joined with warehouses, one for all lines, one for the stock rows
6: one for orders, one for each of the 2 warehouses, one for lines, and two for stock
161: one for orders, one per line, and one per distinct SKU

questions.prompt: A developer adds `line.product.title` inside the inner list comprehension of recent_order_views, without touching the loader options. What happens?
choices: Each access silently issues one extra SELECT, so the report still works but slows down
SQLAlchemy batches the lookups into one query on the first access, because the session already holds the lines
The product titles are returned from the identity map because the SKUs were already queried for stock
An InvalidRequestError is raised on the first access, since the relationship is mapped with lazy="raise" and was not eagerly loaded

questions.prompt: An order contains a SKU that has no stock_items row for the order's warehouse. What does the corresponding LineView report?
choices: in_stock is False, and no error is raised
A KeyError propagates out of recent_order_views
in_stock is True, because a missing row means stock is untracked
The whole order is omitted from the result
